operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin -> Tires: a new 'Compare suppliers' panel sits at the top. Type a tire size (225/65R17, 2256517 or 225 65 17) and a quantity (default 4), tap 'Check suppliers'. Two cards show Best price and Quickest arrival (supplier, Local/Regional, cost unless 'Hide cost' is on, availability and the usual 30-60 min run for shelf stock); under them every offer with qty, availability and why it lost (short quantity, no price, regional timing unknown). A status row says whether Gateway answered and lists ATD and Capital Tire as not connected. Read-only: nothing orders.
